headline: AI stocks
*had a brutal
week
sentences: AI stocks just had a brutal week.
Investopedia says the Nasdaq and the S&P 500 closed sharply lower on Friday.
The AI trade is getting tested.

comments.text: Every cycle someone says this time is different.
Super Micro down 21% in one week is a lot of volatility for a server company.
Weekly moves are noise until you check what you actually own.
Refreshing my portfolio every five minutes. Does not help.
